title: Kampala Healthcare Portal
summary: A patient intake and appointment platform for a growing clinic network.
challenge: Manual bookings created duplicated records, delayed call-backs, and made it hard for the operations team to see appointment demand across locations.
approach: VeilCode designed a responsive portal with guided intake forms, appointment request workflows, and an admin dashboard for front-desk coordination.
outcome: The clinic team gained a cleaner operating view, reduced repetitive booking work, and made patient follow-up easier to manage from one place.

deliverables.title: Patient intake flow
deliverables.desc: Structured forms for triage and appointment requests.

deliverables.title: Operations dashboard
deliverables.desc: A staff workspace for tracking requests and follow-up status.

testimonial.quote: The portal gave our front desk a cleaner operating rhythm.
testimonial.name: Miriam Akello
